verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single help-center category listing that names memory (记忆) among Kimi's general features, which suggests some persistence of user context across conversations. Nothing describes custom instructions or preference settings, or shows that they shape every response. Missing for 10: documented custom-instructions or system-preference settings, details on how memory persists and is applied to responses, user controls for editing that memory, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
